changelog: Turn a written homeroom week plan into one homeroom week voice clip per labeled cue.

en.description: Turn a written homeroom week plan into one homeroom week voice clip per labeled cue. This weekly class voice studio records each week plan voice and class notice audio from the plan the teacher already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 homeroom voice pack files. Use it for homeroom weekly voice packs that keep one arrangement on each clip.
en.summary: Turn a written homeroom week plan into one homeroom week voice clip per labeled cue.
en.title: Homeroom Week Voice: Week-Plan Forwardable Clips
